verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents setup only through degit templates powered by Vite and through adding babel-preset-solid to Babel, webpack or rollup configs, which all involve a package manager or build step. Nothing mentions a CDN script-tag or buildless usage mode. One community comment that Solid is 'easy to inject into other pages' is adjacent and does not show script-tag use without a bundler.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the framework directly via a script tag without needing a package manager or bundler
